summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.41/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.41 a gallon across Wisconsin as of November 22, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 26¢ lower than a week ago, 82¢ lower than a month ago, and 63¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Sheboygan ($3.05) and the highest in Mosinee ($3.74).
